title: Webster Central Schools
subtitle: Quebec city January 28-31, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Webster Central Schools. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel Day to Quebec City & Ice Skating

  • Travel to Quebec City!
  • Quebec City Walking Orientation and Exploration with Tour Director
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Ice Skating
  • Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (three nights)
 

Day 2: Ride the Toboggan Slide at Dufferin Terrace & Plaines D’Abraham

  • Group sit-down breakfast
  • The Snowshoer at Plaines D’Abraham
  • Ridge the Toboggan Slide at Dufferin Terrace
  • Lunch 
  • Hôtel de Glace/Winter Park
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Guided Tour of The Battles at Plaines D’Abraham
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: Château Frontenac & Montmorency Falls

  • Group sit-down breakfast 
  • Guided Tour of the Château Frontenac
  • Visit the Montmorency Falls
  • Free time in Vieux Québec
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 4: Dog Sledding & Departure for Home 

  • Group sit-down breakfast
  • Dog Sledding Adventure at Aventures Nord-Bec Stoneham
  • Lunch
  • Departure for Home
introHeading: Webster Central Schools, get ready for an unforgettable Quebec City adventure in 2027!
introText: From snowy adventures to historic landmarks, this winter journey through Quebec City brings history and excitement to life at every turn. Students will explore the charming streets of Old Quebec, glide across outdoor skating rinks, race down the famous toboggan slide, and experience the beauty of Montmorency Falls in winter. Along the way, they’ll discover the stories of the Plains of Abraham, visit the iconic Fairmont Le Château Frontenac, and enjoy unforgettable experiences like dog sledding and the Hôtel de Glace. It’s the perfect mix of learning, culture, and winter fun—an experience your students will never forget!
